checks.evidence: PBD speed restriction calculation upon receipt of trackside data, steps 1-2: OBU calculates the restriction and it is present in the speed profile. No explicit V1 value or National Values, but the computation and application are verified.

PBD speed restriction recalculation only when inputs change, step 2: the OBU recalculates when an input (gradient) changes. The input differs from the reference (emergency brake confidence level via National Values) but the recomputation behaviour is the same.

invented: Gradient is stated as a changing input via new PBD data from trackside, and brake type, start/end location and PBD distance are listed as PBD data content, which the requirement does not state
Precondition that the OBU is in FS, OS, LS or AD mode with a valid Movement Authority is not stated in the requirement
